==Biography==
== Trivia ==
* Represented China at the [[IeSF 9th e-Sports World Championship]].
* Nicknamed '''Xi'an Rank King''' (西安积分王) by Chinese casters.
** The nickname originated during the [[RDAG 2022 East Asia]], as Chinese casters were not allowed to use the word ''kills'' during the official broadcast.
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on February 28, 2023.
** The 38th player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on June 17, 2024.
** The 22nd player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 2000 kills in the LPL on May 4, 2025.
** The 17th player to reach 2000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on September 12, 2025.
** The 38th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on September 12, 2025.
** Was the 42nd player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LPL 2nd All Pro Team x1 (Split 2 2025)
